paragraphs: Digital Ally sells video systems, and the software to manage them, to law enforcement agencies, commercial fleet companies and event security teams. Its product lines include body cameras, vehicle video systems, IP video surveillance systems, storage, and a patented VuLink automatic activation technology.

The homepage leads with a one-piece body-worn camera with an articulated camera head, and notes that subscription pricing is now offered. An in-car video system is pitched on space savings, reliability, and remote access and service. Dashcam A.I. gives drivers immediate feedback by recognizing pedestrians, distracted or drowsy driving, and lane drifting.

Digital Ally was founded in 2004. Stanton E. Ross is its chief executive officer. It reports state contracts and orders from law enforcement agencies, the U.S. Military and commercial fleets in all 50 states and more than 30 foreign countries. Company news on the same page includes the launch of the FirstVu PRO body-worn camera, for which shipping was expected in the first quarter of 2022. The page also records an agreement between a subsidiary, TicketSmarter, and Gannett Co., Inc.

quote.text: At Digital Ally we understand no two customers are alike.
